# Tests of the JSON Schema Test Suite that this module is known to fail.
# TestSuite fails when a test outside this list fails, when a listed test
# passes, and when a listed test is no longer in the suite.
#
# Columns, separated by tabs: category, draft/file, group, test; an
# optional "# note" after a tab says what happened.
#
# Categories (README.md, "JSON Schema Test Suite", explains each):
#   format-asserted        this layer always asserts format; the 2020-12
#                          required tests expect format to be an annotation
#   format-not-checked     a format this layer deliberately does not check
#                          (ignoredFormats in jsonschema.go)
#   format-own-checker     this layer's own checker for the format is laxer
#                          or stricter than the suite
#   format-unknown         the library has no checker for the format
#   regex-go-re2           the library compiles patterns with Go's regexp
#                          (RE2), not ECMA-262
#   content-not-asserted   contentEncoding/contentMediaType are annotations
#                          here; the library asserts them only when asked
#   integer-fraction-zero  a number with a zero fraction is an integer in
#                          every draft (draft-04 says otherwise)

regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \S matches everything but whitespace	Line tabulation does not match	# accepted invalid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \S matches everything but whitespace	latin-1 non-breaking-space does not match	# accepted invalid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \S matches everything but whitespace	paragraph separator does not match (line terminator)	# accepted invalid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \S matches everything but whitespace	zero-width whitespace does not match	# accepted invalid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \s matches whitespace	EM SPACE matches (Space_Separator)	# refused valid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \s matches whitespace	Line tabulation matches	# refused valid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \s matches whitespace	latin-1 non-breaking-space matches	# refused valid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \s matches whitespace	paragraph separator matches (line terminator)	# refused valid data
regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 \s matches whitespace	zero-width whitespace matches	# refused valid data

regex-go-re2	draft2019-09/optional/ecmascript-regex	ECMA 262 regex escapes control codes with \c and upper letter	does not match	# schema refused at compile
